items:
About this space

Sleeps 20!

A vacation dream home! Great location, less than 1 mile from Alys Beach + Rosemary Beach and just STEPS to the DEEDED BEACH ACCESS is this STUNNING 7-bedroom home!

5 COMPLIMENTARY BIKES PROVIDED!

Fire Pit + Cornhole in the Yard!

This 5700+ SF home boasts multiple master suites + living spaces + bunk rooms + built-in bars, PRIVATE HEATED SALTWATER POOL, balconies w/ beautiful gulf views, pool table, shuffleboard, outdoor kitchen, massive open-concept kitchen/living spaces + more!

The space

This gorgeous 7-bedroom, 6.5-bath luxury home is ideally located just a 1-minute walk directly across 30A to the beach and the shimmering emerald waters of the Gulf! Enjoy deeded beach access with no wristbands needed, no lines to wait in, and notably less congestion on the beach here than in surrounding areas!

Designed with big groups in mind, this house is perfect for 3-4+ families who want to vacation together in paradise!

As you enter, you're greeted by beautifully appointed coastal decor, with shiplap, crown molding, white quartz counters, high ceilings, and wide plank wood floors throughout. The first floor has 3 bedrooms, a King bedroom with an en-suite bathroom with a large glass shower + rain showerhead, a Queen bedroom with an en-suite bathroom with a shower/tub combination, and a bunk room with one set of Full-over-Full bunk beds and one set of Twin-over-Twin bunk beds. The bunk room shares the King suite's bathroom, which is also accessible from the hallway.

The remainder of the first floor is built for entertaining, with a spacious living area and a dedicated game room complete with a pool table, shuffleboard, a wet bar with a built-in fridge and sink, a chalkboard wall, couches, and a TV!

Step outside to the stunning private heated saltwater pool, spa, + pool deck and lounge in the shade or sun! Also, the fire pit is perfect for spending an evening under the stars. The gate in the backyard gives direct access from the pool to the 30A bike path, and deeded beach access is just across the street and less than a one-minute walk away! This is the perfect location for enjoying the sun, sand, and sea all day!

Head up to the 2nd floor, where you will find the main living/dining spaces of the home, boasting a dreamy, massive open-concept chef's kitchen! The kitchen has 2 dishwashers, 2 refrigerators, 2 ovens, and 2 full-size sinks! The oversized kitchen island has barstool seating for 8 guests and gives more than enough space for large gatherings. The living room and dining spaces are beautifully designed with coastal decor, and have gorgeous floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors that allow for tons of natural light flow.

Open the sliding doors and merge the interior and exterior spaces! On this 2nd-floor balcony, you will have a great view of the pool below as well as a built-in outdoor kitchen with a gas grill and outdoor living + dining areas. There is one master suite on this floor, complete with a King bed and a private en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a large glass shower + rain shower head. Also on this floor, you will find a darling half bathroom as well as a laundry room with 2 washers and 2 dryers for your use as needed.

Moving up to the 3rd floor, you'll find three additional bedrooms, including two King master suites both with an enormous en-suite bathroom with a luxurious soaking tub, private balcony access, and stunning Gulf views! Additionally, these two rooms each have a built-in wine/coffee bar with a self-filling Keurig + a mini fridge, making for the perfect start or end to your day! The final bedroom is another bunk room, complete with one set of Queen-over-Queen bunk beds and an en-suite bathroom with dual vanities and a glass shower.

There is free off-street parking for up to 5 cars in the driveway, and a fully fenced yard.

This home's exceptional location puts you just moments from some of 30A's most treasured destinations, including The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach, all less than 1.5 miles away! The 30A bike path also runs directly behind the home, providing effortless access to all of this shopping, dining, and entertainment along the coast.

WaterHouse, a beloved local spot for craft coffee, cocktails, and wine, is located right next door, making it easy to start your mornings or unwind in the evenings without ever getting in the car! You're also right by Camp Creek Lake, which offers the perfect serene setting for kayaking, paddleboarding, fishing, and evening sunset strolls.

HOME HIGHLIGHTS:
- 150ft from DEEDED beach access
- Beautiful Gulf views from the 3rd-floor balcony
- Private heated pool with sun shelf
- 5 Complimentary bikes included
- Location less than 1 mile from Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach
- Fenced yard with frontage right on Highway 30A
- 4 King master suites (at least one on each floor)
- Accommodations for 20 guests comfortably
- Built-in outdoor kitchen with gas BBQ grill
- Pool table
- Fire pit
- Cornhole
- Multiple wet bars with mini-fridges (2 in 2 of the King suites)
- All en-suite bathrooms (besides one bunk room)
- Kitchen island that seats 8+
- 2 Full-size refrigerators
- 2 Full-size kitchen sinks
- 2 Washers & dryers
- Multiple living spaces, inside and outside
- Two built-in bunk rooms
- Professionally landscaped
- Walking/biking distance to all the best of 30A!

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 20 Guests):

FIRST FLOOR:
- Game Room with pool table and wet bar
- Bedroom 1 (Master): King bed, en-suite bathroom with large glass shower with dual shower heads (rain shower)
- Bedroom 2: Queen bed, en-suite bathroom with shower/tub combination
- Bedroom 3: Bunk room with one Full-over-Full bunk AND one Twin-over-Twin bunk, shared bathroom with large glass shower with dual shower heads (rain shower)

SECOND FLOOR:
- Living Room
- Dining Room
- Kitchen
- Laundry Room
- Half Bathroom
- Bedroom 4 (Master): King bed, en-suite bathroom with dual vanities, large glass shower with dual shower heads (rain shower)

THIRD FLOOR:
- Bedroom 5 (Master): King bed, balcony access, private wine/coffee bar with mini-fridge and self-filling Keurig, en-suite bathroom with large glass shower + dual vanities + soaking tub
- Bedroom 6 (Master): King bed, balcony access, private wine/coffee bar with mini-fridge and self-filling Keurig, en-suite bathroom with large glass shower + dual vanities + soaking tub
- Bedroom 7: Bunk room with one Queen-over-Queen bunk, en-suite bathroom with dual vanities, large glass shower

There is a pack n' play and air mattress available upon request.

Guest access

There are 5 bikes provided for guests' use- it is only a short ride to Rosemary and Alys Beach, and other local favorites like the Big Chill! Access to the 30A bike path is right outside the home!

Other things to note
-Weddings and other similar events not allowed at this home. Violation of any home rules may result in forfeiture of rental payments and deposits, as well as subject to HOA, community and management fines.
-Please note we provide a starter set of supplies such as toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dishwasher + laundry pods for your stay
-Check in is 4:00 PM & check out is 10:00 AM. These times are strict and late check out will be subject to another day's rental fees.
-Smoking is strictly prohibited..
-All renters must be over 25 years of age, or if under age 25 must be accompanied by a parent/legal guardian
-Pool heating must be for the full duration of your stay and must be requested 48 hours prior to check in and paid before the heater will be turned on. Pool heating cost is $50/night of your reservation, available Oct 1- April 30.
-Damage that occurs will be collected from the renters.
-Southern Holiday Homes can not be held liable for any damage or injury to any persons caused by pool, bikes or other amenities provided to guests.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
